shared_or_similar_visual_information: Two raised interval traces with circular boundary marks on a number line. Compare the traces attached to the marks at 1 and 3 in the left image with the traces attached to the marks at −3 and 4 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The traces cover opposite sides and neither covers the middle value 2. Right image: The two strict traces share the inputs −3 < x < 4.
Rationales: The selected left cue leaves the middle interval uncovered by both traces. The selected right cue admits the middle interval in both traces, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
